items.title: The first degree in which base change fails can be detected over an affine normal base with algebraically closed function field
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma refines a witness for the failure of the base change condition BC(f, n, q) so that the base becomes affine, integral and normal with algebraically closed function field (statement lines 18105-18120). The proof (proof lines 18122-18147) starts from the existing witness, passes to the function field K' of S', and transfers the nonvanishing of R^q h_* Z/dZ to the new diagram using invariance of cohomology under the extension to the separably closed function field and the relative Leray spectral sequence. H2: one base change of the witness plus one transport of the nonvanishing, written out.
